text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan widely criticised for not reacting to Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi's statements belittling Turkey.
- Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller temporarily withdraws the Turkish ambassador to Libya in Gaddafi row.
- Three motions being prepared by opposition parties to investigate Erbakan's visit to Libya.
- Islamist-led government to put final touches on civil servants' pay rise scheme.
- Islamist Labour Minister Necati Celik says Gaddafi is insane.
- Opposition parties urge the government to resign after Islamist premier's scandalous visit to Libya.
- President Suleyman Demirel does not ratify the selling off of Etibank from which $400 million is expected to be raised.
- Leading businessman Sakip Sabanci proposes a six-step formula to save the country.
- Television programme defames Koran courses for children.
